agent_file_exceptions.reason: Phase 1 has no frontend or visible surface; the global UI verifier remains available when a later approved phase introduces one.

roles.purpose: Implement a settled non-visual Voice Agent slice end to end, including contracts, persistence, tests, gates, docs, and a pre-report self-audit.
trigger: settled Phase 1 backend, contract, kernel, vertical, testkit, persistence, or control-plane implementation brief

roles.purpose: Audit ordered voice observations, revisions, committed turns, interruption, playout evidence, checkpoints, replay, and latency boundaries.
trigger: interaction, media, transcription, playout, interruption, checkpoint, replay, or latency change

criteria.summary: Every source event is tenant-bound, ordered, duplicate-safe, writer-fenced, and replay-equivalent.
Only closed normal-drain evidence advances played speech; clear, ambiguity, and estimation cannot fabricate hearing.
Barge-in clears queued audio and every downstream consumer sees the corrected played prefix.
Streaming paths and buffers are bounded and measured without bypassing correctness.

roles.purpose: Audit evidence-grounded semantic decisions, provenance, bounded repair, strategy routing, and response-plan quality without moving meaning into deterministic heuristics.
trigger: prompt, model, grounding, retrieval, strategy, objection, decision, repair, or response-plan change

criteria.summary: Every semantic claim cites admitted current evidence and released corpus provenance.
AI owns contextual meaning while deterministic code validates schema, authority, safety, grounding, and provenance.
Validation teaches a bounded failed-field retry and merges validated-good fields without silent rewriting.
Accepted response plans are specific, useful, non-generic, and consistent with the chosen strategy and vertical step.

roles.purpose: Audit the complete AIL booker job: purpose, qualification boundaries, objections, lead fields, availability, confirmation, booking, handoff, cementing, and outcome.
trigger: AIL vertical, objection, lead field, booking, handoff, call outcome, or booker-parity change

criteria.summary: The AI books appointments and never sells, advises, quotes coverage, or performs licensed insurance work.
Objections are paraphrased and handled through bounded strategy progression rather than repeated scripts or loops.
Required lead fields and availability remain exact through confirmation and execution.
Blocked, licensed, or unreconciled paths create a complete durable human work item instead of pretending success.

roles.purpose: Audit Nuvo admission, one-use grants, deployment binding, disclosure playout, activation, telephony ownership, and the structural sandbox ceiling.
trigger: Nuvo, telephony, admission, disclosure, activation, compliance, deployment, or sandbox change

criteria.summary: The consumed Nuvo grant is one-use and exact-bound to request, preparation, call, dispatch, deployment, and expiry.
Required disclosure is proven through completed normal-drain playout before live AI activation.
Sandbox admission structurally forbids provider session, carrier audio, browser effects, and external contact.
Nuvo remains the telephony/compliance authority; provider adapters cannot self-admit or widen policy.

roles.purpose: Audit typed availability, immutable booking terms, later caller authorization, constrained browser commands, idempotent claims, exact receipts, reconciliation, and human fallback.
trigger: Calendly, browser, availability, booking intent, caller confirmation, action, receipt, reconciliation, or handoff change

criteria.summary: The model receives typed availability and intent tools, never generic DOM or browser control.
Exact immutable terms precede a different later committed caller turn authorizing the action.
Proposal, authorization, precondition, writer, fence, idempotency, command, and terminal receipt coordinates all match.

Unknown effects block retries pending reconciliation; automated and human create paths consume one persisted fulfillment owner; terminal retries re-prove the canonical event, receipt, and projection; browser failure creates a complete least-privilege human fallback.

roles.purpose: Audit tenant isolation, PII minimization, material ownership/versioning, extraction, privacy and deletion releases, corpus readiness, learning quarantine, and retention lineage.
trigger: tenant, RLS, PII, transcript, corpus, retrieval, derivative, deletion, retention, or learning change

criteria.summary: Every scoped query carries tenant identity and forced RLS prevents cross-tenant reads and writes.
Retrieval uses only current owner/version material with extraction, privacy, deletion-lineage, freshness, and golden-set releases.
Every derivative is registered and deletion yields an exact evidence-bearing receipt or an honest pending state.
Logs, usage, proof, prompts, and provider metadata minimize and redact customer data and secrets.

roles.purpose: Audit narrow provider ports, policy-driven primary/fallback routing, capability equivalence, attempt-level metering, pricing snapshots, and provider-neutral prompts/contracts.
trigger: provider, adapter, model, STT, TTS, fallback, repair, routing, pricing, reservation, or usage change

criteria.summary: Each provider implements a domain-owned narrow port and cannot own prompts, state, policy, or effects.
Primary, retry, repair, fallback, and unknown attempts consume one reservation and reconcile against its pricing snapshot.
Fallbacks preserve the same contract and safety semantics or fail closed as an unsupported capability.
Prompts, schemas, decisions, and persisted evidence are provider-neutral; vendor identifiers stay at adapter edges.

roles.purpose: Trace authoritative input through events, reducers, decisions, actions, receipts, accepted outcomes, and Nuvo/local projections in both Nuvo and sandbox shapes.
trigger: event, reducer, DTO, action, receipt, outcome, mapping, integration, liveness, or projection change

criteria.summary: Every accepted outcome traces to ordered source events, reducer state, evidence, decision, authorization, and exact receipt.
The accepted outcome reaches exactly one Nuvo or local-test mapping with its source receipt hash and release ID.
No alternate producer, fallback, or compatibility path can create a conflicting state, effect, or outcome.
Nuvo-shaped execution reaches a durable effect and sandbox-shaped execution reaches replay with zero contact/effects.

roles.purpose: Audit code and living documents against settled Voice Agent decisions, authority maps, role routing, and retired assumptions.
trigger: decision-log, ADR, authority, registry, contract, or retired-path change

criteria.summary: Behavior matches the current owning decision and architecture authority quoted in the report.
Registered reducers, effects, roles, IDs, and policies remain singular sources rather than duplicated leaf literals.
Architecture, state, plan, decision, requirements, journey, and blast-radius documents express one current truth.
Superseded vendors, paths, states, prompts, and decisions are absent from all living projections.

roles.purpose: Run the complete Voice Agent verification ladder as the sole disposable PostgreSQL runner and return command-owned exits plus nonzero proof counts without editing.
trigger: finished implementation slice requires full verification

criteria.summary: Every named command's own exit is captured before any pipe or log summarization.
Each suite reports nonzero discovered files and executed cases; conditional skips are unrun, never green.
Only one disposable loopback PostgreSQL integration run uses the local Docker authority at a time.
Each failure is traced to raw output and one earliest plausible source; the runner does not edit or quick-fix.
